items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: it was used in a picture where Cesar Romero and Faye somebody else

ctx.x: Yeah. If you got on the right breaks, you maybe had a hit on your hand.

But wait, that's not the worst of it. About five years ago, when Deke Watson was down here with the Ink Spots, the groups had changed several times. He told me, in the presence of Walter Pichon, because Walter Pichon introduced me to Deke Watson, he said, there's some of the Ink Spots over there. I said, I don't want to meet them. I said, they're the ones who recorded my number. He said, it isn't their fault. He said, those men were working. Which was true. Yeah, that's right. And he said, come over and meet him.…
It should be a good deal. They paid money for that.
